name: SUDS Planner
author: sudsmedia

sections.description:
SUDS Planner is the content planning tool of the SUDS agency. This plugin connects a client’s WordPress site to the Planner:

  • SEO: SEO title, meta description, canonical, robots, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and schema.org JSON-LD (organization or local business, website, web page, article, author and breadcrumbs) for every page.
  • Switching from Rank Math or SEOPress without losing anything: when a post has no SEO title or description of its own, the plugin uses the ones Rank Math or SEOPress saved (including their title templates and variables), and it also keeps their focus keyword, robots and canonical settings, the Search Console and Bing verification codes, the Google Analytics tag they inserted, the “remove /category/ from URLs” and “redirect attachments” settings, and their redirects (imported into the plugin’s own table). Their data is never changed or deleted, so reactivating them brings everything back. While Rank Math, Yoast SEO, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework or Slim SEO is active, the plugin’s SEO stays off.
  • SEO columns and Quick Edit: “SEO title” and “SEO description” columns in the posts and pages lists (inherited values shown in gray) and both fields in Quick Edit, with a character counter.
  • Sitemap: uses the WordPress core sitemap, without user pages and noindex posts, with last-modified dates. The old sitemap addresses (sitemap_index.xml, sitemaps.xml, post-sitemap.xml…) redirect to it, so the sitemap submitted to Search Console keeps working.

  • Redirects: imported ones keep working, and a 301 redirect is created automatically when the address of a published post or page changes.

  • Public draft preview: a link with a secret code shows that specific unpublished article (draft, pending or scheduled) to anyone who has the link, with the site’s normal layout (Elementor included), without logging in.

  • Review bar: on that preview, the client selects a passage of the text and comments on it, approves the article or requests changes. Everything goes to the post in the Planner.
  • Comments in the editor: the client’s comments are stored with the article (meta box “Client comments (SUDS Planner)”), visible to whoever edits the text.
  • AI crawler visits: counts the visits of AI crawlers and fetchers (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Mistral, Meta AI and others, by user agent) per day and page, in its own table. It stores only the day, the crawler name, the page path and the count; nothing about visitors. SUDS Planner reads the counts with the site token for the client’s SEO report.
  • Form submitted event: when a form is submitted successfully (Elementor, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator), sends the formulario_enviado event to Google Analytics already on the site (gtag, or the Tag Manager dataLayer), with only the form tool and form id. It can be turned off in Settings → SUDS Planner.

The plugin does not change content and does not publish anything on its own: scheduled publishing is done by the Planner through the WordPress REST API, with an application password. All SEO features work on any site, with or without a SUDS Planner token.

External service

The review bar is shown only on a draft preview opened with the client’s link (the preview code plus, at the end of the address, #suds_review=...). It sends the reader’s comments and decisions to the SUDS Planner address configured in the plugin (https://planner.suds.com.br). The AI crawler counts stay on the site and are read only by SUDS Planner with the site token. The form event goes only to the Google Analytics the site already uses; it sends nothing that visitors typed. The plugin loads the Google Analytics tag (googletagmanager.com) only when the site owner sets a GA4 ID in the settings or the SEO plugin used before (Rank Math or SEOPress) was inserting it, and never when Site Kit, MonsterInsights, ExactMetrics or GTM4WP is active: Google’s privacy policy is at https://policies.google.com/privacy. Terms: https://suds.com.br.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zip file in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. In Settings → SUDS Planner, paste the token shown in the client’s record in the Planner (the zip downloaded from that record already includes the token).
  3. In the Planner, under Connected accounts → WordPress, click Test connection.
sections.faq:
Is the preview public to anyone?

Only to whoever has the link with the article’s secret code, and only for that article. Unpublished pages stay invisible to the rest of the site and to search engines (noindex, no cache).

Does the plugin publish the article?

No. Scheduled publishing is done by SUDS Planner through the WordPress REST API, using the application password of the user configured there.
sections.changelog:
1.4

  • SEO: title, meta description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter and schema.org JSON-LD.
  • Takes over from Rank Math or SEOPress using the data they saved (titles, descriptions, templates, focus keyword, robots, canonical, verification codes, Analytics tag, redirects, category base and attachment settings); off while any SEO plugin is active.
  • SEO title and description columns in the posts and pages lists, editable in Quick Edit.
  • Core sitemap without users and noindex posts; old sitemap addresses redirect to it.
  • Redirects table, with automatic 301 when a published post changes address.
  • The Planner token is kept in the settings (also when it came inside the file) and can be set by an administrator through the REST settings endpoint, so updates never lose it.
  • Requires WordPress 5.7 (wp_robots).

1.3

  • AI crawler visits per day and page (REST /suds/v1/bots, with the token) for the SEO report.
  • Google Analytics event formulario_enviado on successful form submissions (can be turned off in the settings).

1.2

  • Scripts and styles of the review bar moved to files and loaded with wp_enqueue_script / wp_enqueue_style.

1.1

  • Preview restricted to the article of the code; review token kept out of the page address; fixed Planner address.

1.0

  • Public draft preview, review bar and client comments mirrored in the editor.
